static_traits.name: Chen An
static_traits.social_status: Interpersonal relationships affected, struggling to build close connections with others; has a few friends to confide in
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; never received similar counseling
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, fairly coherent thinking, highly cooperative; tends to use absolutized, Self-denial expressions, and often negates positive feedback

basic_info.main_problem: Difficulty getting along with family, often feeling disappointed with daily life, and worrying about being abandoned by family due to Relationship tension. These problems have persisted since adolescence, worsening in recent years due to misunderstandings and conflicts.
basic_info.core_demands: Negative emotions are affecting overall well-being and enjoyment of daily life; hopes through counseling to change negative thinking, relieve disappointment and the fear of abandonment, and improve life experience.
growth_experiences: Since adolescence, Strained relationships with family members began, with frequent misunderstandings and conflicts; stress gradually rising from moderate, experiencing disappointment and Fear of abandonment almost daily after interacting with family. Tried distancing from family activities and distracting with interests, but emotional distress persists.

In the past year, sales performance at Work declined; as the company and industry advance toward digitalization and paperlessness, performance comparisons with colleagues intensified self-blame and feelings of 'not being good enough', further affecting relationships with colleagues and self-care and eating habits.
Weak social support: insufficient family support, only a few friends to talk to.

special_situations.event: After interacting with family, emotions intensify due to misunderstanding and conflict
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot get along well with family, the relationship will inevitably worsen, and eventually I will be abandoned by them
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces joining family activities, keeps distance from family, uses interests to distract attention
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will abandon me sooner or later

special_situations.event: At work, sees colleagues achieve performance targets while one's own sales decline
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If my performance is not as good as colleagues', it means I am not suited for this job, I am a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids contacting new clients, avoids situations where failure is possible
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I can never be as good as them

special_situations.event: Receives clients' positive feedback or completes a small sale
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Unless there is significant overall performance improvement, no positive feedback counts
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Attributing success to luck, negating one's own abilities
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This is just luck, not useful

special_situations.event: Receives feedback from the manager about sales targets
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I have not yet met the target, it proves I am not good enough, and it will not improve in the future
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids challenging tasks to reduce the shame brought by failure
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I cannot improve; failing to reach the target is failure

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be steadily accepted and trusted by family and significant others, gaining affirmation and belonging
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being abandoned and Being rejected, worrying about relationship breakdown and elimination
defense_goal: Lowering the risk of injury and being negated through keeping distance and avoidance, maintaining fragile Self-protection

object_relations.self_representation: A not-good-enough child who may be Being rejected at any time
object_relations.object_representation: Family members who easily misunderstand, criticize, and may abandon oneself
Strict supervisors and colleagues who judge value by results

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked or reminded to attend to positive feedback and small successes (e.g. client praise, completing a small deal)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Treating positive evidence as incidental, insufficient to shake the 'loser' self-cognition
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Downplaying positive facts in a flat tone, emphasizing 'luck' 'not important enough', avoiding deep emotional experience.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When misunderstandings or conflicts occur with family, or when sensing the relationship is unstable
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Projecting the inner Anxiety of being abandoned as 'they will definitely leave me/look down on me'
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Expressing guesses about others' negative intentions, withdrawing or distancing interactions in advance in a worried tone.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: Facing tasks with possible failure (such as proactively contacting new clients)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Turning external pressure and Fear of failure toward the self, Reinforcing self-blame to avoid external conflict
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using self-critical expressions (such as 'It is all my problem'), low tone, ending conversations or actions with avoidance.

manifestations: Weak family support, hard to build close connections with others
After interacting with family, frequently experiences fear of abandonment
Distancing from family activities for Self-protection
outcomes: Reduced sense of social connection and isolation

manifestations: Often Fantasying escaping reality in a daydream-like way
Work performance affected by emotional distress

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Interprets the inner fear of abandonment as 'my family is going to abandon me'
Experiencing others' success in the workplace as negation of oneself

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: Frequently using absolutized Self-denial (such as 'I am a failure' 'I cannot improve')
Avoids contacting new clients to avoid possible failure

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves.
manifestations: Reduces participation in family activities, turning the urge to repair relationships into self-alienation
Uses distraction (interests and hobbies) instead of direct communication or seeking support

exception_events.target_problem: When comparing with colleagues at Work or receiving performance feedback, the client usually develops 'I am not good enough / I am a failure' thoughts, then avoids contacting new clients, leading to further performance decline.
exception_events.unique_outcome: Last month completed several relatively difficult deals, with clients expressing satisfaction with the service; currently experiencing some affirmation, unlike the past blanket view of failure.
exception_events.reason: Clue: that time obtained the client's positive feedback and concrete successful experience, providing observable evidence for ability, making them briefly weaken the 'failure' narrative.

positive_force: Has actual successful experience (completed several difficult deals last month)
Positive attitude, willing to try reality testing and restructuring thinking
Has a few trustworthy friends to confide in and for support
negative_force: Catastrophizing and jumping to conclusions (mind reading, predicting the future)
negating positive feedback, maintaining the failure self-schema
Avoidant behavior (reduced family interaction, avoiding contacting new clients)
persistent insecurity from fear of abandonment and lack of family support

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids contacting new clients and challenging tasks
antecedent: Thinking of the recent sales decline
target_behavior.core_reason: all-or-nothing perception of one's abilities and catastrophic prediction (believing 'it cannot improve' 'another failure would prove I am a failure')
target_behavior.function: avoiding possible failure and shame, temporarily reducing anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: further decline in performance,Tense relationships with colleagues,lowered Self-efficacy

antecedent: Misunderstandings and conflicts after interacting with family
Premonition that the relationship will worsen or one will be abandoned
target_behavior.core_reason: Fear of abandonment and catastrophic interpretation of relationship breakdown
target_behavior.function: Escapes being judged and conflict, maintains short-term safety
target_behavior.consequence: Family relationships growing more distant, increased Loneliness and insecurity

target_behavior.behavior: negating positive feedback and attributing success to luck
target_behavior.core_reason: maintaining the 'failure' core belief, avoiding the discomfort of cognitive inconsistency by negating positive evidence
target_behavior.function: lowering expectations of self-worth to avoid anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: positive experiences weakened,Self-efficacy hard to improve, persistent low mood and self-blame
